The stealth features synthetic leather and a manual recline mechanism. Cup holders in each arm add to the utility of the chair. The patented XZipit system provides endless logo options on the front of the chair and allows you to showcase your favorite team or interest.

title: PhantomX Mesh Gaming Chair with Arizona Diamondbacks City Connect Logo
description: Designed to provide maximum ergonomic comfort, the Phantom properly supports your weight while aiding with posture and supporting your lumbar region. The Phantoms mesh back and seat cradle your body while keeping you cool with added air flow and temperature regulation. Made to suit a wide variety of body types, workstation setups and tasks by adjusting to each individual user. The chair back moves and glides vertically with you throughout the day, keeping your spine in alignment and continuously supporting the lower back. The seat is adjustable forward or back to provide the perfect seat depth and distance from the backrest, and the added headrest supplies full height support and neck relief. The Phantom is truly the most cost effective ergonomic mesh style gaming chair on the market.

title: Xpression Pro Gaming Chair with Arizona Diamondbacks City Connect Logo
description: The Xpression PRO Gaming Chair builds upon our 1st generation Xpression Gaming Chair by introducing several additional features and enhancing some of our fans' favorite elements. The Xpression PRO continues to provide exceptional body support and boasts an adjustable, contouring, durable, and fully reclining seat. With increased padding in the seat and back, the Xpression PRO Gaming Chair is an ideal choice for streamers seeking extra comfort. We've also incorporated a five-star metal base and included two magnetic pillows—one for lumbar support and another for the head and neck. Of course, it wouldn't be a Zipchair without the ability to proudly display an embroidered logo! The Xpression PRO sets new standards for quality, comfort, and stability, meeting and exceeding your expectations for a gaming chair.

title: SuiteMax 3.5 VIP Seats with Florida Panthers 2024 Champions Logo
description: Bring the VIP seating experience home with the SuiteMax 3.5. Easy to install both inside and outside, the SuiteMax will transform your home media room, theater, or fan cave into the ultimate viewing experience or line your basketball, pickleball or tennis court with the SuiteMax for an unbeatable outdoor seating section.

title: Bar Stool 500 with Florida Panthers 2024 Champions Logo Set of 2
description: This set of two offers a sleek and affordable entry point into any fan cave or home bar. Bring the Bar Stool 500 home and seamlessly integrate your favorite team into any space. With its sturdy, yet comfortable seat and seatback, it's perfect for family and friends to sit in for hours. The compact design allows for easy, unintrusive storage. It has never been easier and more affordable to furnish your home bar, fan cave or rec room with bar stools featuring your favorite teams logo.

title: Stealth Power Plus Recliner with Florida Panthers 2024 Champions Logo
description: The Stealth Recliner Power Plus has a power recline which is perfect for your living room, man cave, home theater, or anywhere you want to recline and relax in total comfort. Combining sleek lines, maximum comfort, a compact footprint and a power recline, the Stealth is perfect for any budget. Featuring a synthetic leather, cup holders in each arm, USB ports and optional add-ons like a swing table, tablet holder, wine glass holder and a flex light, the Stealth Power Plus is perfect for watching your favorite live sporting event, movie or television series. The patented XZipit system provides endless logo options on the front of the chair and allows you to showcase your favorite team or interest.

title: PhantomX Mesh Gaming Chair with Florida Panthers 2024 Champions Logo
description: Designed to provide maximum ergonomic comfort, the Phantom properly supports your weight while aiding with posture and supporting your lumbar region. The Phantoms mesh back and seat cradle your body while keeping you cool with added air flow and temperature regulation. Made to suit a wide variety of body types, workstation setups and tasks by adjusting to each individual user. The chair back moves and glides vertically with you throughout the day, keeping your spine in alignment and continuously supporting the lower back. The seat is adjustable forward or back to provide the perfect seat depth and distance from the backrest, and the added headrest supplies full height support and neck relief. The Phantom is truly the most cost effective ergonomic mesh style gaming chair on the market.

title: Game Rocker 100 with Florida Panthers 2024 Champions Logo
description: The Game Rocker 100 is the perfect choice for any console, hand held, or mobile gaming enthusiasts. The side mounted speaker system provides high-quality audio for added immersion in games. The chair wipes clean and folds easily for storage. Since the Game Rocker 100 features the XZipit system, you can showcase your favorite team or league. The full media control system allows you to just directly connect to your device and game-on.

title: Xpression Pro Gaming Chair with Florida Panthers 2024 Champions Logo
description: The Xpression PRO Gaming Chair builds upon our 1st generation Xpression Gaming Chair by introducing several additional features and enhancing some of our fans' favorite elements. The Xpression PRO continues to provide exceptional body support and boasts an adjustable, contouring, durable, and fully reclining seat. With increased padding in the seat and back, the Xpression PRO Gaming Chair is an ideal choice for streamers seeking extra comfort. We've also incorporated a five-star metal base and included two magnetic pillows—one for lumbar support and another for the head and neck. Of course, it wouldn't be a Zipchair without the ability to proudly display an embroidered logo! The Xpression PRO sets new standards for quality, comfort, and stability, meeting and exceeding your expectations for a gaming chair.

title: Swivel Bar Stool 2000 Florida Panthers 2024 Champions Logo
description: Perfect for your bar or around a pub table, you can even use it behind low seating to create a stadium feel. The Bar Stool Swivel 2,000 incorporates contemporary styling with durable full 360 degree swivel base, sturdy 18 gauge powder coated steel frame and upholstered vinyl seat. Features designed for commercial or home usage. The patented XZipit system provides endless logo options on the front and back of the chair and allows you to showcase your favorite team or interest. Additional rear logo panel available.

title: Phantom Mesh Gaming Chair Removable Headrest Ergonomic Lumbar Support
description: Designed to provide maximum ergonomic comfort, the Phantom properly supports your weight while aiding with posture and supporting your lumbar region. The Phantoms mesh back and seat cradle your body while keeping you cool with added air flow and temperature regulation. Made to suit a wide variety of body types, workstation setups and tasks by adjusting to each individual user. The chair back moves and glides vertically with you throughout the day, keeping your spine in alignment and continuously supporting the lower back. The seat is adjustable forward or back to provide the perfect seat depth and distance from the backrest, and the added headrest supplies full height support and neck relief. The Phantom is truly the most cost effective ergonomic mesh style gaming chair on the market.

title: Portable Lightweight Inflatable Display Pillow - Logo Insert Purchased Separately
description: Zipchair makes it easy to reuse & showcase any logo panel by turning them into a display pillow! Simply blow up the inflatable pillow insert and zip the embroidered logo panel onto the pillow ends and in seconds you have a new way to display and store the same beautifully embroidered logo panels that adorn your Zipchair furniture. This is the perfect accessory for any Zipchair owner to display multiple panels all year long! *Logo panels can be purchased separately*

title: PhantomX Mesh Gaming Chair with Cleveland Guardians Wordmark
description: Designed to provide maximum ergonomic comfort, the Phantom properly supports your weight while aiding with posture and supporting your lumbar region. The Phantoms mesh back and seat cradle your body while keeping you cool with added air flow and temperature regulation. Made to suit a wide variety of body types, workstation setups and tasks by adjusting to each individual user. The chair back moves and glides vertically with you throughout the day, keeping your spine in alignment and continuously supporting the lower back. The seat is adjustable forward or back to provide the perfect seat depth and distance from the backrest, and the added headrest supplies full height support and neck relief. The Phantom is truly the most cost effective ergonomic mesh style gaming chair on the market.
